title: EVENTEAS
tagline: A Twitter Thread-Like DApp built with Attestation system (EAS) for Optimism, Mode,  Zora and Base
description: A Twitter Thread-Like DApp built with an Attestation system (EAS) for Optimism, Mode,  Zora, and Base. The project is Multi-chain. it was deployed to Optimism- goerli testnet, zora testnet, base testnet and Mode testnet. Users can login with Metamask, verify their personhood with World ID and tweet events that is happening around them.
how_its_made:
Still building but this is what i have used, 
Frontend: React, Tailwind, Postcss, Worldcoin World ID, Metamask
Smart Contract: Solidity,
Chains deployed: Optimism Goerli testnet, Mode testnet, Base Testnet and Zora Testnet
Creating EAS Schema was one of the fun of this hack. Javascript and typescript was used to connect smart-contract to the frontend for communication.
